title: inga multijuga subsp. aestuariorum
intro: Inga multijuga subsp. aestuariorum, commonly known as a tropical tree species, is a sub-species of the Inga multijuga plant. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, manage diabetes, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Inga multijuga subsp. aestuariorum include acting as an antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
